query: WITH entities AS ((SELECT score, id FROM transfers WHERE status = $1 AND ((score, id) > ($4, $3)) AND ($3 IS NOT NULL AND $4 IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY score ASC NULLS FIRST, id ASC LIMIT $2) UNION ALL (SELECT score, id FROM transfers WHERE status = $1 AND ((score IS NOT NULL OR id > $3)) AND ($3 IS NOT NULL AND $4 IS NULL) ORDER BY score ASC NULLS FIRST, id ASC LIMIT $2) UNION ALL (SELECT score, id FROM transfers WHERE status = $1 AND ($3 IS NULL) ORDER BY score ASC NULLS FIRST, id ASC LIMIT $2) ORDER BY score ASC NULLS FIRST, id ASC LIMIT $2) SELECT i.id AS "entity_id!: Repo__Id", e.sequence, e.event, CASE WHEN $5 THEN e.context ELSE NULL::jsonb END as "context: es_entity::ContextData", e.recorded_at, NULL::jsonb as "forgettable_payload?" FROM entities i JOIN transfer_events e ON i.id = e.id ORDER BY i.score asc nulls first, i.id asc, i.id, e.sequence
